paragraphs.text: Pontotoc City School District lists Warriors Without Limits, a special education parent resource night, for Tuesday, Nov. 17.
The district calendar gives the time as 5 to 6:30 p.m. at Pontotoc Elementary School, 145 Fred Dowdy Avenue in Pontotoc.
Families can review the official event listing and use its Google Calendar or iCalendar links to save the date. The district’s central-office number is 662-489-3336.
